51:2: By those that carry a burden.
51:3: Then by those that flow with ease.
51:4: By those that apportion the affairs.
51:5: Surely what you are promised is indeed true.
51:6: And surely the judgment (reckoning) will certainly occur.
51:8: Surely you are indeed in differing speech.
51:9: Turned away from it is whoever is turned away.
51:11: Those who are in heedlessness, bewildered.
51:12: They ask: 'When is the Day of Judgment?'
51:13: That Day they are put to trial upon the Fire.
51:14: Taste your trial; this was what you were seeking to hasten.
51:15: Surely the righteous are in gardens and springs.
51:16: Having taken what their Rabb gave them; surely they were doers of good before this.
51:17: They used to sleep but a little of the night.
51:18: And at the dawns they would ask for forgiveness.
51:19: And in their wealth was a right for the petitioner and the deprived.
51:20: And on the earth are signs for those who are certain in faith.
51:21: And in your own selves, do you still not see?
51:22: And in the heaven is your provision and what you are promised.
51:23: So by the Rabb of the heaven and the earth, surely it is definitely true, just as you speak.
51:24: Has the story of Abraham's honored guests reached you?
51:25: When they entered upon him and said, 'Salam.' He said, 'Salam, you are an unrecognized people.'
51:26: Then he turned quickly to his family and brought a fat calf.
51:27: He placed it near them; he said: 'Will you not eat?'
51:28: Thereupon he felt a fear of them. They said: 'Do not fear!' and they gave him glad tidings of a knowledgeable son.
51:29: And his wife came forward in a cry, struck her face and said: 'An old woman, barren!'
51:30: They said: 'Thus said your Rabb. Surely He is the Wise, the Knowing.'
51:31: He said: 'What is your errand, O messengers?'
51:32: They said: 'Surely we have been sent to a guilty people.'
51:33: To send upon them stones of clay,
51:34: Marked in the presence of your Rabb for the transgressors.
51:35: Then We brought out whoever was in it of the believers.
51:36: And We did not find in it other than a single house of Muslims.
51:37: And We left in it a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
51:38: And in Moses too there is a lesson; We had sent him to Pharaoh with a clear proof.
51:39: Then he turned away with his support and said: 'A magician or a madman.'
51:40: So We seized him and his hosts and cast them into the sea, while he was blameworthy.
51:41: And in 'Ad too there is a lesson; when We sent upon them the barren wind.
51:42: It left nothing that it came upon except that it made it like decayed matter.
51:43: And in Thamud too, when it was said to them: 'Enjoy yourselves for a time.'
51:44: They defied the command of their Rabb, so the thunderbolt struck them while they were looking on.
51:45: So they were not able to stand up, nor were they of those who were helped.
51:46: And the people of Noah We destroyed before. Surely they were a defiantly disobedient people.
51:47: And the heaven, We built it with strength, and surely We are expanders.
51:48: And the earth We spread out, and how excellent are the spreaders!
51:49: And of everything We created pairs, that you may take heed.
51:50: Therefore flee to Allah; surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.
51:51: And do not make another deity along with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.
51:52: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them except that they said: 'A magician or a madman.'
51:53: Did they bequeath this to one another? Nay, they are a transgressing people.
51:54: So turn away from them; you are not blameworthy.
51:55: And remind, for surely the reminder benefits the believers.
51:56: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me.
51:57: I do not desire from them any provision, nor do I desire that they feed Me.
51:58: Surely Allah is the Provider Himself, the Possessor of power, the All-Firm.
51:59: Surely for those who do wrong there is a portion like the portion of their companions; so let them not ask Me to hasten.
51:60: Woe to those who disbelieve from their Day which they are promised!
